summary: Steakholder Foods Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 2, 2026, amending prior prospectuses to reset the at-the-market capacity under its August 1, 2024 sales agreement with H.C. Wainwright. The supplement permits sales of up to $4,036,262 of American Depositary Shares under General Instruction I.B.5, with prior ATM sales of roughly $4,131,609 already completed. No price per share, premium, or closing date is stated. Wainwright acts as sales agent for a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown capacity update, not a special situation.
